# Colonial Electric

> Colonial Electric is a licensed and insured Massachusetts electrician in Weymouth, MA, serving Weymouth and the South Shore with residential and commercial electrical services. Founder: Scott Hays. MA Lic# 8720-A1. Phone: (781) 287-8729.

Website: https://colonial-electric.com/. Everything below is taken from the pages on this site; follow a link for the full page.

## About

- [About Us](https://colonial-electric.com/about-colonial-electric/): At Colonial Electric, we’re committed to providing top-notch electrical services throughout the South Shore. We prioritize delivering excellent service and strive to forge lasting relationships with our customers. Count on us to meet your electrical needs with the utmost quality and care.
- Founder, Scott Hays learned the value of hard work and the power of lending a helping hand at such an early age.
- Locally Owned. Licensed, Bonded & Insured. Transparent & Upfront Pricing. Family-run Business.
- Find Peace of Mind With Our Lifetime Craftsmanship Guarantee.
- Licensed & Insured Massachusetts Electrician: Serving Weymouth & the South Shore. (MA Lic# 8720-A1)

## Services

- [All services](https://colonial-electric.com/services/)
- [Permanent Outdoor Lighting](https://colonial-electric.com/permanent-outdoor-lighting/): Create the perfect ambiance for your outdoor space with our versatile and intelligent outdoor lighting system.
- [Electrical Outlets](https://colonial-electric.com/electrical-outlets/): No more messy cords or limited access to power sources! Our electrical outlet services ensure that you have convenient access to electricity wherever you need it. Whether it’s for your home or business!
- [Electrical Panel Upgrade](https://colonial-electric.com/electrical-panel-upgrade/): Our team specializes in upgrading outdated panels to meet current safety standards and accommodate increased electrical loads. Enjoy safe, and energy-efficient power!
- [Surge Protection](https://colonial-electric.com/surge-protection/): Shield your valuable electronics from harmful power surges with our surge protection services. Safeguard your appliances and devices against voltage spikes, ensuring their longevity and reliability.
- [Ceiling Fan Installation](https://colonial-electric.com/ceiling-fan-installation/): Enhance comfort and energy efficiency in any room with our professional ceiling fan installation services. Enjoy improved air circulation, reduced energy costs, and added aesthetic appeal.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://colonial-electric.com/ev-charger-installation/): Join the revolution with our E.V. charger installation services. Experience the convenience of charging your electric vehicle at home, ensuring you’re always ready to hit the road.
- [Whole House Wiring or Rewiring](https://colonial-electric.com/whole-house-wiring-or-rewiring/): Upgrade your property’s electrical system with our whole-house wiring or rewiring services. From outdated systems to new construction projects, our team can handle it.
- [Electrical Inspections](https://colonial-electric.com/electrical-inspections/): Ensure the safety and reliability of your electrical system with our comprehensive electrical inspection services. Our team will meticulously assess wiring, outlets, panels, and more!
- [Recessed Lighting](https://colonial-electric.com/recessed-lighting/): Illuminate your space with style and sophistication using recessed lighting services. Achieve a sleek and modern look while maximizing light distribution and energy efficiency.
- [Remodels](https://colonial-electric.com/remodels/): Transform your home or business with professional electrical remodeling. Whether you’re updating a single room or renovating your entire property, you can trust our expert electricians.
- [Lighting Additions](https://colonial-electric.com/lighting-additions/): Brighten up your surroundings with our lighting services. From elegant chandeliers to practical under-cabinet lighting, we offer custom solutions tailored to your needs!
- [Whole Home Battery Back Up](https://colonial-electric.com/whole-home-battery-back-up/): Embrace reliability with our whole-home battery backup services. Keep your place running smoothly, even during power outages, while reducing your carbon footprint.
- [Generator](https://colonial-electric.com/generator/): Never be left in the dark again! Our generator services provide reliable backup power for your home or business, ensuring uninterrupted electricity during outages. Stay powered up and worry-free.
